releaseNotes:
• App version 2.1.1 release
• Real-time heads-up incoming message notifications with partner direct action
• Overhauled Chat UI with Scaffold-pinned header and isolated composer to eliminate keyboard lag
• Reverse-anchored messages list preventing keyboard jitter and maintaining recent messages visibility
• Ultra-premium floating dock bottom navigation bar with animated pill tabs, unread indicators, and Pale Sky/Raspberry accents
• Typing indicator network debouncing and long-press clipboard copy on messages
